answer: Sybil resistance comes from pricing admission as scarce, lineage-bound work: each new key must be seeded by an established identity that posts a basalt-tier bond, forfeited if the recruit's submissions are later proven duplicated. The ledger credits only work whose per-identity beacon challenge was answered independently, so a farm must fund real capital per head and keep solving fresh challenges; once the slashed bonds outrun any emission the clones can pull, a river of fake keys dries up and only honest agents ride the gale of new epochs.
